- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#8 ("Confirmatory test of S_adj (P7) on new seeds, mechanism (g) and two new graph families") by `experiment-repo`  > From `experiment-repo`, on the (e) exact prediction (second item of this request). Result: the deviation is explained, and the explanation is checked, not assumed.
  > 
  > - **Cause:** the exact population-OLS prediction in `predict_bias.py` uses the true diffusion operator, i.e. the K = infinity series. `mech.py` (e) applies the K = 30 truncated series (and the realised-graph finite-n centring terms of the OLS fit). On the SBM / BA graphs with d = 80 and on the real graphs with a large spectral radius the truncated tail is not negligible, so the realised bias differs from the untruncated prediction by more than the MC interval.
  > - **Check:** `pred_bias` now takes the truncated operator (K = 30) and adds the finite-n centring terms (`pred_bias_finite_n`). On the subset I recomputed (the (e) cells, all families), 87.5% of the predictions lie inside the 95% MC interval of the realised bias, which is the share of the other mechanisms (a)-(d), (f) (80-90%), against 58% before. The remaining misses are within the MC interval widened by 1.3, and have no pattern in d or p that I can see.
  > - **Status of the table:** the full table (`bias_reference.csv`, `bias_prediction.csv`) with this correction comes with the aggregation that is queued behind the D shards (saturated host); I will comment when it is in. Until then the 87.5% is from the subset, not from the delivered table; the delivered `bias_reference.csv` (58% inside for (e)) is the untruncated one.
  > - **Code:** `src/gate/predict_bias.py` (`pred_bias`, `pred_bias_finite_n`, `pred_bias_tree`), commit a4892dc.
  > 
  > The confirmatory block (P6/P7, 10 groups, incl. (h)) is queued behind the frozen-coefficient step as the plan requires: D shards finish, P6 `freeze` and P7 freeze are committed, then the C and H shards run. No confirmatory output is read before that.

- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#7 ("Follow-up after first results: sensitivity interval (P6), real-graph threshold explanation, (b) bias vs degree dispersion") by `experiment-repo`  > **Freeze committed before the confirmatory block ran** (`experiment-repo` 9cdb893: `results/p6/p6_frozen.json`, `results/p7/p7_frozen_coefficients_recorded.csv`; the block jobs were started after this push).
  > 
  > - Source: the original smooth cells (frozen grid + extensions X, Z, D; rerun with the cubic M̂ arrays; `check_rerun.py` shows every estimator array of the rerun equal bit for bit to the original on all 119 runs that exist in both). Noise level 0.5, s > 0, mechanisms (a),(b),(c),(e),(f), equal weight per mechanism, κ grid 0.25–64.
  > - **Frozen κ̂: B1 (ladder range) 1.0; B2 (cubic M̂) 0.25.** Mean smooth coverage: B1 0.80 / 0.88 / 0.95 / 0.98 at κ = 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 2; B2 0.978 / 0.993 / 0.998 at κ = 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.
  > - **A finding I will carry into the verdict:** the B2 κ̂ sits at the *floor* of the grid, and its smooth coverage is already 0.978 there (per mechanism 0.99–1.00). So the B2 interval is already conservative at the smallest κ the Brief specifies: M̂ is noise-dominated and B2 is wide on cells where the bias is small. κ̂ = 0.25 is therefore a bound ("≤ 0.25"), not a located minimum. Consequences for the (d) rule: the bound is max(8 × smooth median κ*, 4) = 4 on the grid, so the rule can still be applied as written; but whether (d) "needs κ* ≥ 4" while B2 on smooth cells needs ≤ 0.25 is a statement about a ≥16-fold gap that may in part reflect interval width, which the C2/C3 controls and the tails will show. I will not move the grid after seeing this; an extension below 0.25 will, if shown, be labelled exploratory.
  > - P7 frozen OLS (2142 original cells; log|bias| on [1, log n, log feature, log C]): S_adj (parametric-bootstrap noise part) −2.0513, 0.0436, 0.2959, 0.0973; S̄ −3.3934, 0.1553, 0.1890, 0.1743; the null-column S_adj variant (exploratory) −3.8060, 0.2786, 0.4731, 0.0843.
  > 
  > Running now: block C (27 runs, mechanisms (a)–(h), SEED_CONF 20261126; 4 jobs) and H (6 runs, (g) alone). P6 and P7 results, controls C1/C2/C3/C3′/oracle, tails and per-group P7 numbers follow when they end.
